Bauliche Angaben, Mindestempfehlungen, Größe und Ausstattung: (1) Die Gemeinschaftsunterkunft wird an den AN in einem ordnungsgemäßen Zustand übergeben, der den jeweils geltenden bau-, gesundheits-, brand- und unfallschutzrechtlichen Vorschriften entspricht. It also includes the Construction of 2 no. new 4 storey residential blocks to provide 32 no. apartments and all associated parking, roads and ancillary services. Tenderers are required to tender 3 no. options including a Phased Delivery and ‘DVR only’. GSC remains confident that the housing element will be funded in a timely fashion and the build out will comprise both elements. This site in Turners Cross is a substantial inner suburb site and the desirability of the build out of both aspects of the scheme is reflected in the passage of the Part VIII through Cork City Council. Nevertheless, the various options are set out to prudently allow for receipt of funding confirmation. Subject to tender responses, the DVR has been fully approved for funding.
